title: Vietnam keeps US talks amid 35% tariff proposal
content:
Vietnam will continue US engagement through a Section 301 investigation and talks on a reciprocal trade deal, Luong Hoang Thai said.
The US has proposed extra tariffs of up to 35 per cent on Vietnamese goods, or 20 per cent if the agreement is reached.
Vietnam has supplied information and is preparing firms for 2026-2030 trade risks.

title: India's growth remains resilient amid uncertainties: Goyal
content:
India's growth story remains strong amid global uncertainties, Finance Minister Piyush Goyal said at the India Debt Capital Market Summit 2026. 
He cited 7.8 per cent first-quarter growth, about 12 per cent growth in gross fixed capital formation and $570 billion exports in the first seven months. 
Goyal said India is on track for $1 trillion exports, with EU and US trade agreements progressing.

title: India’s cotton output may fall 14.3% in 2026-27: Agri Min
content:
India’s cotton output is projected to fall 14.33 per cent to 24.866 million bales in 2026–27, with area and yields both lower.
First advance estimates show acreage down 3.78 per cent and yield down 10.98 per cent, signalling a fourth straight annual decline.
Lower availability may lift import dependence, reduce exportable surplus and affect yarn, textile and apparel competitiveness.

title: South India’s cotton yarn market subdued as export demand slows
content:
South India’s cotton yarn market stayed subdued as weak offtake, liquidity constraints and slower Bangladesh demand curbed mill price hikes.
Tiruppur was stable, while Mumbai saw marginal declines; traders expect summer garment manufacturing to lift yarn demand.
Gujarat cotton steadied after losing ₹1,000–1,200 (~$10.81–12.97) per candy, with national arrivals at 145,000–150,000 bales.

title: Bangladesh Minister urges RMG factories to reopen from Saturday
content:
Bangladesh's labour minister has said garment factories are expected to resume production from Saturday after a wage board fixed a new minimum monthly wage for workers. 
The board set the minimum at Tk 17,000 (~$136), up from Tk 12,500 (~$100), after being formed on November 1 amid worker protests. 
He urged workers and owners to keep operations free from disruption.

title: Hong Kong's YGM Trading narrows H1 loss as margin improves
content:
Hong Kong’s YGM Trading narrowed its first-half net loss to HK$157,000 (~$20,032) from HK$1.597 million a year earlier. 
Revenue fell 16 per cent to HK$66.129 million (~$8.44 million) as garment sales weakened. 
Gross margin rose to 62.9 per cent from 58.5 per cent, while distribution costs fell 20.3 per cent. 
A gain on the sale of a subsidiary also helped narrow losses.

title: Indonesia’s apparel export prices rise 4% in January-September 2026
content:
Indonesia’s apparel export price rose 4.1 per cent year on year in January–September 2026, lifting export value by 3.63 per cent despite a 0.40 per cent fall in volume.
Exports totalled $6.760 billion, with the average price at $22.67 per kg, up from $21.78 per kg a year earlier.
The US stayed the top market with a 57.23 per cent share, as 2026 growth shifted towards higher unit prices.
